description.zh:
高频备份频率，取值说明：

- **-1**：不开启高频备份。
- **30**：每30分钟。
- **60**：每1小时。
- **120**：每2小时。
- **180**：每3小时。
- **240**：每4小时。
- **360**：每6小时。
- **480**：每8小时。
- **720**：每12小时。

>- 当**SnapshotBackupType**取值为**Standard**时，该参数取值固定为**-1**。
>- 当**SnapshotBackupType**取值为**Flash**，且该参数取值大于0时，高频备份才生效。
description.en:
The frequency of high-frequency backups. Valid values:

- **-1**: High-frequency backup is disabled.

- **30**: every 30 minutes.

- **60**: every 1 hour.

- **120**: every 2 hours.

- **180**: every 3 hours.

- **240**: every 4 hours.

- **360**: every 6 hours.

- **480**: every 8 hours.

- **720**: every 12 hours.

> * If you set **SnapshotBackupType** to **Standard**, the value of this parameter is -1.
>
> * High-frequency backup takes effect only if you set **SnapshotBackupType** to **Flash** and set this parameter to a value greater than 0.

description.zh:
全量备份保留天数。

> - 2021年09月10日前用户默认保留天数为7天。
> - 2021年09月10日后新用户默认保留天数为30天。
description.en:
The number of days to retain full backups.

> - For instances that were created before September 10, 2021, the default retention period is 7 days.
>
> - For instances that are created after September 10, 2021, the default retention period is 30 days.

description.zh:
备份保留策略。

- 0：实例释放时立即删除该实例的所有备份集

- 1：实例释放时会自动备份，长期保留该备份集
- 2：实例释放时会自动备份，并长期保留该集群的所有备份集

详细信息请参见：[长期保留备份](~~2779111~~)
description.en:
The policy to retain backups when you release the instance.

- 0: All backup sets of the instance are deleted when the instance is released.

- 1: An automatic backup is performed when the instance is released, and this backup is retained for a long time.

- 2: An automatic backup is performed when the instance is released, and all backup sets of the instance are retained for a long time.

For more information, see [Long-term backup retention](~~2779111~~).

description.zh:
异地备份的保留时间。

1. Monday：周一
2. Tuesday：周二
3. Wednesday：周三
4. Thursday：周四
5. Friday：周五
6. Saturday：周六
7. Sunday：周日

> 异地备份必填
> - 传入多个值，请用英文逗号（,）隔开。
> - 当备份设置为常规备份时，该值需要为 PreferredBackupPeriod 备份周期的子集。
description.en:
The days of the week to perform geo-redundant backups. Valid values:

1. Monday

2. Tuesday

3. Wednesday

4. Thursday

5. Friday

6. Saturday

7. Sunday

> This parameter is required if you enable geo-redundancy.
>
> - To specify multiple days, separate them with commas (,).
>
> - If you set the backup method to conventional backup, the days of the week specified by this parameter must be a subset of the days of the week specified by PreferredBackupPeriod.

description.zh:
异地备份操作策略：

- update: 修改异地备份策略
- delete: 删除异地备份策略

> 异地备份必填
description.en:
The policy for geo-redundant backups. Valid values:

- update: Modify the geo-redundancy policy.

- delete: Delete the geo-redundancy policy.

> This parameter is required if you enable geo-redundancy.

description.zh:
异地日志备份保留类型。

- delay（保留一段时间）
- never（不过期）

> 异地备份必填
description.en:
The retention policy for cross-region log backups. Valid values:

- delay: Retain the backup for a specified period.

- never: Retain the backup permanently.

> This parameter is required if you enable geo-redundancy.

description.zh:
异地日志备份保留时长，可设置 3-1825 天，需要小于等于CrossRetentionValue的值。


> 异地备份必填
description.en:
The number of days to retain cross-region log backups. Valid values: 3 to 1825. The value must be less than or equal to the value of CrossRetentionValue.

> This parameter is required if you enable geo-redundancy.

description.zh:
异地备份保留类型。

-  delay（保留一段时间）

- never（不过期）

> 异地备份必填
description.en:
The retention policy for geo-redundant backups. Valid values:

- delay: Retain the backup for a specified period.

- never: Retain the backup permanently.

> This parameter is required if you enable geo-redundancy.

description.zh:
异地备份保留时长，可设置 3-1825 天。

> 
> - 异地备份必填
> - 当 CrossRetentionType 为 delay 时使用且必须使用。
description.en:
The number of days to retain geo-redundant backups. Valid values: 3 to 1825.

> - This parameter is required if you enable geo-redundancy.
>
> - This parameter is required if you set CrossRetentionType to delay.

description.zh: 实例ID。
description.en: The instance ID.

description.zh:
备份所在地域。


> 异地备份必填
description.en:
The region ID of the geo-redundant backup.

> This parameter is required if you enable geo-redundancy.

description.zh:
是否打开日志备份，取值说明：
- **0**：关闭（默认值）。

- **1**：打开。
><notice>分片集群不支持关闭日志备份></notice>
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable log backup. Valid values:

- **0**: Disable log backup. This is the default value.

- **1**: Enable log backup.

><notice>

You cannot disable log backup for sharded cluster instances.

></notice>

description.zh:
是否开启跨地域日志备份 。

> 异地备份必填
> - 1： 打开  (分片集群必须为1，副本集如果想支持异地时间点恢复必须为1)
> - 0： 关闭
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable cross-region log backup. Valid values:

> This parameter is required if you enable geo-redundancy.
>
> - 1: Enable cross-region log backup. This value is required for sharded cluster instances. This value is also required for replica set instances if you want to enable geo-redundant point-in-time recovery.
>
> - 0: Disable cross-region log backup.

description.zh: 高频备份保留天数，使用该参数前需要先确认已经传入BackupInterval字段。默认保留时长一天。
description.en: The number of days to retain high-frequency backups. Before you specify this parameter, you must set the BackupInterval parameter. The default retention period is 1 day.

description.zh:
实例类型，取值：
- replicate 
- sharding

>- 当备份恢复类型为已删除实例重建时，需要且必填
>- 当备份恢复类型为异地备份克隆时，需要且必填
description.en:
The instance type. Valid values:

- replicate

- sharding

> * This parameter is required when you restore a deleted instance.
>
> * This parameter is required when you clone an instance from a geo-redundant backup.

description.zh:
日志备份保留天数，默认为7天。

取值范围：7~730。
description.en:
The number of days to retain log backups. Default value: 7.

Valid values: 7 to 730.

description.zh:
备份周期，取值说明：
- **Monday**：周一。
- **Tuesday**：周二。
- **Wednesday**：周三。
- **Thursday**：周四。
- **Friday**：周五。
- **Saturday**：周六。
- **Sunday**：周日。

><notice>为了数据安全，请一周至少备份两次MongoDB></notice>


> 传入多个值，请用英文逗号（,）隔开。
description.en:
The backup cycle. Valid values:

- **Monday**

- **Tuesday**

- **Wednesday**

- **Thursday**

- **Friday**

- **Saturday**

- **Sunday**

><notice>

To ensure data security, back up the MongoDB instance at least twice a week.

></notice>

> To specify multiple backup cycles, separate them with commas (,).

description.zh: 执行备份的时间，格式为HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 > 时间范围限制为1小时。
description.en:
The time range to perform a backup. Specify the time in the *HH:mm*Z-*HH:mm*Z format. The time is displayed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

> The time range must be 1 hour.

description.zh:
是否开启按小时稀疏备份。

- true：当备份频率为分钟级时，距离当前时间1小时内的快照全部保留。距离当前时间超过1小时且在24小时内的快照，仅保留整点后的第一个快照。

- false：高频备份保留天数内的快照全部保留。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable hourly sparse backup. Valid values:

- true: If the backup frequency is in minutes, all snapshots that are generated within the last hour are retained. For snapshots that were generated more than 1 hour ago but less than 24 hours ago, only the first snapshot that is generated after each full hour is retained.

- false: All snapshots are retained within the high-frequency backup retention period.

description.zh:
快照备份类型，取值说明：

- **Flash**：秒级备份。
- **Standard**：常规备份（默认值）。
description.en:
The snapshot backup type. Valid values:

- **Flash**: second-level backup.

- **Standard**: conventional backup. This is the default value.

description.zh:
实例所在地域。

> 
> - 已删除实例恢复必填
> - 异地备份必填
description.en:
The region ID of the instance.

> - This parameter is required if you restore a deleted instance.
>
> - This parameter is required if you enable geo-redundancy.

descriptions.zh: 异地备份只适用于云盘副本集、云盘分片实例。
descriptions.en: Geo-redundancy is available only for replica set instances and sharded cluster instances that use cloud disks.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds modify-backup-policy --db-instance-id dds-bp16cb1627710000 --preferred-backup-time 03:00Z-04:00Z --preferred-backup-period Monday,Wednesday,Friday,Sunday --backup-retention-period 30 --enable-backup-log 0 --log-backup-retention-period 7 --snapshot-backup-type Standard --backup-interval -1 --high-frequency-backup-retention 1 --backup-retention-policy-on-cluster-deletion 2 --cross-backup-type update --src-region cn-beijing --dest-region cn-hangzhou --cross-retention-type delay --cross-retention-value 7 --cross-backup-period Monday,Tuesday,Wednesday,Thursday,Friday,Saturday,Sunday --enable-cross-log-backup 1 --cross-log-retention-type delay --cross-log-retention-value 3 --instance-type replicate --preserve-one-each-hour true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dds ModifyBackupPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --HighFrequencyBackupRetention 1 --PreferredBackupTime '03:00Z-04:00Z' --BackupRetentionPolicyOnClusterDeletion 2 --CrossBackupPeriod 'Monday,Tuesday,Wednesday,Thursday,Friday,Saturday,Sunday' --PreferredBackupPeriod 'Monday,Wednesday,Friday,Sunday' --CrossLogRetentionType delay --LogBackupRetentionPeriod 7 --CrossRetentionValue 7 --CrossBackupType update --SrcRegion 'cn-beijing' --CrossRetentionType delay --CrossLogRetentionValue 3 --EnableCrossLogBackup 1 --PreserveOneEachHour true --DBInstanceId 'dds-bp16cb1627710000' --SnapshotBackupType Standard --EnableBackupLog 0 --BackupRetentionPeriod 30 --InstanceType replicate --DestRegion 'cn-hangzhou' --BackupInterval '-1'
